description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a 'My Day' task screen, displaying a list of tasks for the current day with options to toggle completion, view details, and add new tasks.

classes.name: MyDay
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the 'My Day' screen showing tasks for the current day.

classes.name: _MyDayState
classes.description: State class managing the list of tasks and UI interactions for the MyDay widget.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Fetches all tasks from the database and updates the tasks list in state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the 'My Day' screen, including app bar, task list, and add task button.
